basis: Da Afghanistan Bank quarterly economic bulletin explicitly attributes its published CPI and inflation analysis to data supplied by the National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA). Evidence: "Since being revised by the National Statistics and Information Authority (NSIA), consumer price index (CPI) in Afghanistan has been compiled on the base prices of April 2015 while previously; it was calculated on the base prices of March 2011. Similarly, in this revision, the CPI components are also aligned with new weights. As per data from the (NSIA) and analysis of Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB), the following results were observed in the consumer price index of Afghanistan."

IMF e-GDDS DQAF metadata for Afghanistan National Accounts states that basic data for the finance, insurance and real estate sector are provided by Da Afghanistan Bank (DAB) in aggregated form for central bank and commercial banks operations. Evidence: "Finance, insurance, and real estate Basic data are provided by DAB in aggregated form for central bank and commercial banks operations. In-house surveys are conducted for money service providers including money changers and lenders."

Somalia National Bureau of Statistics CPI Methodological Note (May 2025) states the transition from COICOP 1999 to the latest COICOP 2018 classification for the modernized national CPI basket and weights. Evidence: "Transitioning from COICOP 1999 to the latest COICOP 2018 classification. COICOP 2018 introduces more detailed consumption categories, including a fourth level (subclass) for granular analysis, expands divisions from twelve to thirteen by splitting Insurance and Financial Services and Personal Care and Miscellaneous Goods... A total of 537 items from the SIHBS were classified according to the 9-digit COICOP 2018 structure, and over 1,300 items in the CPI basket were realigned with new COICOP codes."
